src: In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me some advice that I've been turning over in my mind ever since.
tgt: 在我年轻且更易受伤害的那些年里，父亲给过我一句忠告，我至今念念不忘。

src: Whenever you feel like criticizing any one, he told me, just remember that all the people in this world haven't had the advantages that you've had.
tgt: 每当你想要批评别人的时候，他告诉我，要记住这世上并非所有人都拥有你那样的优越条件。
